scope: CPython video source-level review; not a Docker build or human viewing/listening acceptance.

designBrief.reader: Curious English-speaking adult familiar with strings, not CPython storage internals.
designBrief.question: Why does this single U+1F600 addition nearly quadruple the str object while UTF-8 barely changes?
designBrief.argument: One representation width applies across the new str; separate UTF-8 encoding preserves one-byte ASCII and adds only four bytes for this face.
designBrief.visualResponsibilities: Diagram makes every sampled ASCII cell widen from 40 to 160 pixels; text explains the code-point threshold; comparison uses common bytes-per-pixel scale for object-size and payload bars.
designBrief.direction: Dark opening, light mechanism, dark conclusion; exact host Clawpilot variables, rose accent, Segoe UI/Aptos stack, no cards or dashboard.
designBrief.type: 52px headings, 44px figures, 32px primary labels, 20px source/measurement notes, 22px version eyebrow.
designBrief.assets: Hand-authored inline SVG face; no emoji-font dependence, images, remote fonts, external assets or CDN.
designBrief.scopeReduction: Latin-1 and BMP intermediate examples stay in the dossier; they are not crammed into the 20–30 second pilot.

narrationReview.completeNarrationLocation: video-plan.json / segments[].text (all three segments; no separate narrated Markdown)
narrationReview.timingStrategy: Budget is a future measured-audio acceptance range, not a verified duration. Fifty words suggest a roughly 20–25 second planning estimate at ordinary delivery, but Edge output and pauses are unmeasured. Use actual segment durations; never force length by time-stretching. If outside budget or captions overflow, revise narration and obtain fresh approval.
narrationReview.previewTiming: Helper samples hypothetical 210-frame scenes for geometry only. It does not claim 21-second audio duration or subtitle alignment.
narrationReview.futureDisclosureScope: Only the exact approved three narration strings and necessary voice/rate metadata may go to Edge TTS. Never send the Dossier, source code, code excerpts, measurement audit or preview notes.

sceneReview.mechanism: Dark baseline with code-point length and 100049 B object size; six one-byte a cells stand for the long ASCII prefix. A locally drawn, explicitly U+1F600-labelled face moves toward the row.
sceneReview.editorialFinding: Names CPython and str object size in the opening, avoiding a generic memory/file-size headline.
sceneReview.visualReview: Source geometry reviewed only; no screenshot or browser observation.

sceneReview.mechanism: Light mechanism. All seven cells deterministically change width; six unchanged ASCII code points and the appended face occupy four-byte slots. Final labels show 100001 code points and 400080 B. The U+FFFF threshold and new-result/unchanged-original note bound the claim.
sceneReview.editorialFinding: The cause and consequence are linked explicitly. Geometry is a schematic of the result representation, not measured allocator progress or mutation of the old str.
sceneReview.visualReview: Source geometry reviewed only; actual overlap, clarity and caption fit are untested.

sceneReview.mechanism: Dark bookend. Object-size bar grows near fourfold; the UTF-8 bar changes by 0.004 percent on the same scale, with explicit +4 B label so the tiny difference remains readable. Exact baseline/result values remain visible.
sceneReview.editorialFinding: Object size versus UTF-8 payload is explicit. One natural on-screen line identifies measurement on CPython 3.11.15, sys.getsizeof(str), UTF-8 payload length and PEP 393. Parent-observation provenance and bytes-object overhead exclusion remain in research/QA.
sceneReview.visualReview: Source formula and units reviewed, not runtime-observed.

semanticResearchReview.result: Source-supported within pinned and supplied-observation scope.
semanticResearchReview.readExtent: Official PEP relevant sections, sys.getsizeof raw section, Unicode HOWTO Encodings and selected Unicode Support sections, complete pinned PyUnicode_New/PyUnicode_Concat/unicode_sizeof_impl bodies, selected header helper/declaration context. Not entire CPython files, a full interpreter trace, or full PEP tail.
semanticResearchReview.measurementOrigin: Actual existing parent observation on local CPython 3.11.15. This author did not rerun it. Exact build details and observation execution timestamp were not supplied.
reviewCorrections: Do not say every emoji forces four-byte storage.
Do not describe concat as an exact maximum-code-point scan; it combines representation-range upper bounds.
Do not animate or narrate the old immutable string changing in place.
Do not equate sys.getsizeof(str), encoded payload length, bytes-object size, file size or process memory.
Research timestamps were recorded from the actual tool batches and normalized to whole-second RFC 3339 for validator compatibility; no observation timestamp was invented.
limitations: PEP and implementation share lineage and are not independent empirical studies.
Source and observation agree but the exact runtime dispatch of the parent's expression was not traced.
Small strings, already-wide strings and different builds/object caches need not have the same ratio.
No human comprehension evaluation or external peer review was performed.

sourceInventory.role: Non-executable metadata; bound research and three coverage blocks.
Self-contained HTML/CSS/inline SVG/inline JavaScript. Two scripts: mandatory host theme detection, then deterministic scene construction/renderFrame.

sourceBehavior: Only creates/updates local DOM, reads scoutTheme and system theme, and exposes window.ahaVideo plus window.ahaPilotState.
Source contains no fetch, XMLHttpRequest, WebSocket, storage, forms, workers, eval, external module, remote asset or local file access.

No wall clock, randomness, autonomous timers, CSS animation or accumulated animation state. Each renderFrame sets visible scenes, geometry, opacity, text, theme and semantic state from supplied frame inputs.
A/B/A reproducibility is a source-level intent, not yet an observed result.
Initial source calls renderFrame once when later loaded; opening the HTML is code execution and remains unapproved.
sourceAndResourceReview.localFonts: Uses system Segoe UI, Aptos, Calibri and fallback families; no font files copied or downloaded. Actual font substitution/readability still requires approved browser QA.
sourceAndResourceReview.resourceProvenance: New hand-authored explanatory SVG face and geometry. Minimal public CPython function excerpts remain in the separate Dossier only, with pinned URLs and hashes; no CPython code executes in the artifact.
sourceAndResourceReview.helperInventory: tools/preview.mjs uses Node built-ins, the bundled safe CLI and already-present playwright-core 1.55.1. It requests existing Edge; installs/downloads are absent.
sourceAndResourceReview.helperReviewBoundary: Review the helper and HTML at the recorded identities before explicit --allow-code. SourceHash/planHash gates are checked using bundled explain-check/video-plan-check, not guessed hashes. Helper is outside the project's sourceHash and therefore has its own SHA-256.
sourceAndResourceReview.helperIsolation: Fresh QA directory and explicit fresh unsigned-in Edge profile under it; 1280x720 viewport; offline context; service workers blocked; route fulfillment serves only the reviewed HTML bytes for fixed localhost document URLs with no real HTTP server. Other requests abort; CSP blocks connections/resources. This is browser-level isolation, not an OS sandbox or packet-audited guarantee against Edge background traffic.
sourceAndResourceReview.helperCapabilities: Reads the two source/plan identities and HTML, invokes safe CLI validation, launches existing Edge, executes reviewed source, and writes sampled PNG/state reports plus a fresh browser profile only under this pilot's qa/<fresh-name>. It never synthesizes speech or renders MP4.
sourceAndResourceReview.helperBudget: 60-second preview race; 15-second browser launch and CLI timeouts; 8-second browser action timeout; context closes in finally. Caller should additionally enforce an outer process timeout for browser-close hangs.
sourceAndResourceReview.helperStatus: Authored and source-reviewed; never executed, imported, syntax-run or browser-tested in this task.
